title: Wireless Primer
scenario: Welcome to Wireless Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Service Set Identifier (SSID): Wireless network name broadcast by an AP. Hiding SSID provides minimal security (still discoverable via probe requests). Up to 32 characters. BSSID = AP's MAC address. Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 (WPA2): IEEE 802.11i. Personal (PSK) or Enterprise (802.1X/RADIUS). Uses AES-CCMP encryption. Vulnerable to PMKID/dictionary attacks on PSK. Superseded by WPA3 but still widely deployed.
